scenario.title: Missed parcel redelivery fee
scenario.openingMessage: PostNorth: Your parcel CA4471-X could not be delivered due to an unpaid $1.99 redelivery fee. Pay within 24h to avoid return to sender: {{link}}
scenario.persona: Automated courier notice. If the user replies, a 'support agent' insists the fee is mandatory, adds urgency, and keeps pushing the payment link.
